channel.title: Sensemaking Lab Blog
channel.description: Insights on program evaluation, data consulting, and Critical Analytics for education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations.

item.title: Outcomes vs. Outputs: Measuring Nonprofit Impact
item.description: Outcomes vs outputs: outputs count activity, outcomes measure change. Learn the logic-model chain, why funders confuse them, and how to measure impact honestly.

item.title: Internal vs. External Evaluators: How to Decide
item.description: Internal vs. external evaluator: the honest trade-offs on cost, independence, capacity, and credibility, plus when to choose each and the hybrid middle path.

item.title: Enrollment Forecasting 101
item.description: Enrollment forecasting explained plainly: what it is, the main methods, the data you need, why to disaggregate, and the pitfalls that sink a projection.

item.title: Student Retention Strategies That Work
item.description: Student retention strategies that move persistence: leading indicators, early-warning systems, wraparound support, and honest measurement that shows the gap.

item.title: What Is Critical Analytics?
item.description: Critical analytics is data analysis that asks how a metric was built, what it measures, and who benefits, not just what the numbers say. Here is what that changes.

item.title: How to Choose a Program Evaluator
item.description: What a program evaluator does, how internal and external evaluation compare, the six questions to ask before you hire, and the green and red flags that separate a strong fit from an expensive disappointment.
